title.suggested: Kilrain's Age Compared With Old Champions Including Goss and McCool

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic, discussing Jake Kilrain's age, noted that Joe Goss was 38 when he beat Tom Allen in Kentucky for the American championship and that Mike McCool was 36 when he fought Allen for $2,000.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Saturday Morning, February 2, 1895, page 6. Only punctuation fix (St. with period). Dateline New York, Feb. 1. Tag Legacy does not strictly apply (written before 1903); retrospective mention.

facts.fact: Joe Goss, aged 38, defeated Allen in Kentucky for the championship of America
Mike McCool, aged 36, fought Allen for $2,000 and the championship
